declarations: danger_signal_threshold: TRANSLATED as a one-day reaction of 1x atr_14d off the day's high, not literal 6 points (C7, C18-C20); the multiplier is my translation

timing rule: ACT_NOW where the name sits within ~2% of its 20-day high; WAIT where a reaction is still under way and the new high must print first

answers.text: "Under +40% volume is a C16 hard rejection." Volume is not my confirmation; fill difficulty is not served to me. My test is the new high after a normal reaction: D HH/HL, 1.6% over the swing high but 2.9% under the 20-day high, so the new high has not printed. `subcomponents.flow.volume_score` 2.0 is a weight I already named; I act only on a close above the 52w closing high.

"elder 7.0 after three 10s, swing maturing." Elder is advisory only to me. My wear read is `subcomponents.energy.exhaustion_score` 10.0 = untouched, `mp` 92.0 with W over EMA9 9>21. The H1 LH/LL is a minor swing my method filters out (C21); a stall then a 1x atr_14d reaction from the rally top (C20) would move me, not the impulse colour.

"rs_accel -0.7 lead fading, no fresh measured base." `subcomponents.structure.base_days` 1497.0 is a long base, and a break of a long base to a new high is sound to me (C16). `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` -0.7 is a small erosion, noted. D 0.3% over the swing high is thin clearance (C19), which is why my trigger is the new 52w closing high, not this break.

"base_days 4.0, no base; 20.8% past the swing high." I do not need a counted base; I need a trend and a new high (C5). W and D both HH/HL, 0.3% under the 20-day high: it is AT its high, not chasing above it. `subcomponents.energy.exhaustion_score` 10.0 = no wear. The extension is real; my guard is the danger signal (1x atr_14d, my translation), not a base count.

"Price governed by the pending AWK merger: event-driven." This stands on my own engine: event-driven names are not mine to nominate, and a price tied to a deal is not a free trend whose new high means strength (C2). `structure` 84.2 and `mp` 97.0 still read a trend, but I cannot separate it from the deal. I concede and stand aside.

"Not a reclaim day; elder 7.0, green gone." Elder is advisory to me, and 'reclaim' is not my buy test anyway. My test: D HH/HL but 2.0% under the last swing high, so no new high yet. `flow` 53.9 (`sc_m_gates` False) is a weight. I hold SUPPORT only on a close above the 52w closing high; nothing to buy before it.

"day_vol 0.87 on the BOS fails C16." Volume is not my test. My Key Price test (C14) is two related names: KO and CHD both broke structure together. But D is 0.4% over the swing high and 4.6% under the 20-day high, H1 9<21: no fast follow-through (C17). So WAIT for the new high, not a buy on this break.

"cmf -0.09 and flow 36.8 = selling or thin." Money-flow is not my confirmation; price at a new high is. W 0.2% and D 0.4% under the swing high: no fresh break yet. `structure` 87.4 and `mp` 97.0 hold the trend. `flow` 36.8 keeps me at low conviction; I act only on the new 52w closing high.
